figures.caption: Fig. 2. SAGE3D architecture. The encoder uses four Set Abstraction layers with Point Transformer blocks; CentroidGNN modules at SA2 and SA4 boost corner features. The decoder upsamples via 3-NN interpolation with skip connections.
Fig. 3. k-NN grouping at different depths. Same K covers larger spatial extent in deeper layers.
Fig. 4. CentroidGNN probability boost (∆p). Red regions show increased corner confidence after excitatory message passing.
